Star Map is a subclass-specific resource for Druids of the Circle of the Stars.

Overview

Star Maps are a limited resource that allow Circle of the Stars druids to cast their own version of  Guiding Bolt without having to spend Spell Slots.

Circle of the Stars druids gain 2 Star Maps at Level 2 and an additional Star Map at levels 5 and 9, for a total of 4.

Recovering Star Maps

Star Maps are fully replenished on a Long Rest or respeccing with Withers.
